Suspect Arrested in Arson Attack at Canadian MP's Home

Toronto police have arrested one suspect in connection with an arson attack that destroyed two vehicles outside the home of Liberal Member of Parliament Salma Zahid. The incident occurred overnight on August 27. Police have also indicated that a second suspect is wanted in connection with the case. The motive for the attack has not been disclosed.
